items.summary: BigQueryFeatureTheAI.AGG functionisgenerally available(GA). You can use this function to semantically aggregate unstructured inputdata based on natural language instructions.Cloud BillingFeatureSpend cap budgets are now generally available for a limited set of servicesForeligible services,you can configure a spend cap budget to automatically pause usage when yourestimated spend exceeds the budget amount you set. You can manage spend capbudgets in theBudgets page in the Google Cloud consoleand using theCloud Billing Budget API.Spend caps are a cost control mechanism. A spend cap is enforced when usagecosts exceed your budget target amount. When enforced, any new request to theeligible services, within the specified project, are paused and no furtherusage costs are accrued until the spend cap is lifted. You can manually lift anenforced spend cap, or wait until the start of the next month when thespend cap is automatically lifted.Spend caps use gross, estimated costs to trigger the alerts and caps,enforcing a cap much faster than the actual costs are processed and appearon billing reports. Even though faster than reports, the enforcement of spendcaps isn't instant and any cost overages are billed as normal.More information about spend cap budgetsFor managing spend cap budgets in the Google Cloud console, see:How spend cap budgets work to help you control spendLimitations of spend cap budgetsConfigure a spend cap budgetLift an enforced spend capFor managing spend cap budgets using the Cloud Billing Budget API, see:Using the Cloud Billing Budget API for spend cap budgetsSpend cap budget concepts and limitationsCreate a spend cap budgetLift an enforced spend capCloud Billing Budget API REST referenceCloud SDKBreaking589.0.0 (2026-10-13)Breaking Changes(Google Cloud CLI) Deprecated the skaffold component in Google Cloud CLI. The component will be removed from Google Cloud CLI releases after January 15, 2027. A portion of gcloud components install skaffold attempts now return an error. Please install Skaffold following the instructions at https://skaffold.dev/docs/install/.Google Cloud CLIUpdated Linux and Windows bundled Python to install cryptography 46.0.7 from the official PyPI wheels instead of custom builds.Updated the Alpine-based Docker images (:alpine, :VERSION-alpine) to use a bundled Python and no longer include a system python3.Updated bundled Python to 3.14.8 on Linux and Windows, and in the Alpine-based Docker images. This updates the OpenSSL that Python uses for TLS to 3.5.9.AlloyDBAdded --enable-express flag to gcloud beta alloydb clusters create|update.ApigeePromoted gcloud apigee apis delete to GA. The command deletes an API proxyand all of its revisions. Every command in gcloud apigee apis now servesGA.Fixed an issue where gcloud apigee apis import --from-template discarded atemplate's endpoints and targets whenever the template referenced afeature. A template that declared its own topology and used features only forpolicies compiled to a proxy with no ProxyEndpoint, and the import failed.A template's endpoints and targets now seed the proxy, and features areapplied on top of them.App EngineFixed an issue where gcloud beta app migrate-to-run dropped the ServerlessVPC Access connector for deployed versions.Fixed an issue where gcloud beta app migrate-to-run mapped App EngineFlexible instance_ip_mode to Cloud Run ingress.Fixed an issue where gcloud beta app migrate-to-run did not route allegress through Direct VPC for internal-only App Engine Flexible apps.App Lifecycle ManagerHid the deprecated gcloud beta saas-runtime command group. Existingcommands continue to work and print a deprecation warning. Use gcloud betaapp-lifecycle-manager instead.BeyondcorpDeprecated gcloud beta beyondcorp app command group.BigLakeAdded --service-directory-name flag to gcloud biglake delta-sharing catalogs update.BigQueryAdded support for Azure Data Lake Storage URIs (abfs:// and abfss://) ininline external table definitions (--external_table_definition).Added --dataplex_entry_group flag to bq mk --transfer_config andbq update --transfer_config to allow integration with Dataplex EntryGroups.Added support to filter Transfer Configs by Dataplex Entry Group using--filter="metadata_destination.dataplex_configuration:*" forbq ls --transfer_config.Cloud AlertingPromoted gcloud monitoring alerts command group to GA.Cloud ComposerUpdated gcloud composer environments storage dags export,gcloud composer environments storage data export,gcloud composer environments storage plugins export,gcloud beta composer environments storage dags export,gcloud beta composer environments storage data export, andgcloud beta composer environments storage plugins export to skip, with awarning, objects that would be written outside of the local --destinationdirectory.Cloud DNSAdded gcloud beta dns outbound-endpoints command group.Added --outbound-endpoints flag to gcloud beta dns managed-zones and gcloud beta dns policies.Cloud FirestorePromoted
